screenshots.caption: Real keyboard input: A then Q in the air gives the Japan Grab. The text label stands in for the clip.
A fresh W tap before Q on the ground: Swag Surf (Nia, Up). The panel at the top right shows the fresh window of R3.
Route bot: Rail Grind with GRIND held.
The grind-to-manual link: GRIND held off the rail end. The balance bar (F1) shows beside the skater, with zone patterns and W/S arrows.
Off the kicker: a left tap and TRICK give the Japan Grab; the combo line shows the links and the multiplier.
The first 3-link combo with a manual banks.
Grayscale: the balance bar reads from the hatching, the marker shape, and the W/S labels (R12.4).
Pixel 7: a flick right from TRICK in the air. The ring shows 4 arrows with the short trick names; the lit arrow is the resolved direction (Side Grab).
Pixel 7: a flick up from SPIN starts ATL Rydin (8 beats). The touch layout keeps 5 buttons: JUMP, GRIND, TRICK, SPIN, SWITCH.
